examples.en: Some of the most important questions remain unanswered.
examples.zh: 一些最重要的问题仍未被答复。

examples.en: Many questions about the crime remain unanswered.
examples.zh: 这桩罪行涉及的许多问题仍然没有答案。

examples.en: The key question of what caused the leak remains unanswered.
examples.zh: 泄漏究竟是怎么造成的，这一关键问题仍未得到答案。
